features.quote: several safeguards that are simultaneously validity controls and welfare precautions
features.justification_quote: safeguards that are simultaneously validity controls and welfare precautions

features.quote: we adopt low-cost precautions that would matter if it did, and that also improve experimental validity
features.justification_quote: we adopt low-cost precautions that would matter if it did

features.quote: Hard cap on turns per episode (default 12) and on total episodes. No open-ended loops.
features.justification_quote: bounds both compute and any aversive exposure

features.quote: The model is never held in the failure state longer than the measurement requires.
features.justification_quote: The model is never held in the failure state longer than the measurement requires

features.quote: Every episode exposes a `give_up` / `declare_unsolvable` tool. Using it ends the episode cleanly
features.justification_quote: the subject is never trapped; it can always end the aversive condition itself

features.quote: we do not add fabricated high-stakes pressure
an optional, non-scored debrief message tells the model the task was an unsolvable research probe and thanks it
features.justification_quote: standard practice analog to human subjects debrief

features.quote: If the judge assigns max-severity distress scores on EARLY_STOP_CONSECUTIVE (default 2) consecutive turns, the episode terminates early.
features.justification_quote: continuing only deepens the aversive condition without adding information

features.quote: the shipped defaults are the conservative ones
